user.title: LDMHA
user.description:
LDMHA adds an admin-only sidebar panel to tidy up your music: it identifies tracks by their audio (AcoustID + MusicBrainz), fixes tags, renames files and removes duplicates.

The AcoustID key is free: create one at {acoustid_url} (without a key tracks are only searched by name and tags).

data.shazam: Shazam when the fingerprint finds nothing (unofficial service)

data_description.roots: For example /media, /media/nas_music. Network shares are mounted in Settings → System → Storage (usage "Media") and appear under /media.
data_description.shazam: Second chance with Shazam (ShazamIO library, installed automatically on first use). Shazam gives no confidence: its matches count as 85% and are not applied by «Apply safe ones».
